annotation.comment:
[BSP reconstruction 008f2260]
Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_scene_property_bag, read-only analysis. __thiscall(ScenePropertyBag* /*ECX*/, const char* key), RET 4. Splits the key at the first '.' (_strchr at 008F228A); with no dot it builds a native string and calls the map find 0043B8B0 on this+4, returning *(node+8) (the 38h property record) or 0. With a dot it copies the head into the shared global buffer 00F89658 (so the routine is not reentrant), looks that up, and recurses on the tail at 008F232B with ECX = record+0Ch only when *(record+4) == 6, which is what makes type 6 the nested sub-bag. An absent property is reported as EAX = 0 with no out-of-band error and no default. See docs/SCENE_PROPERTY_BAG.md.
